assets.name: otter_ref
assets.prompt: Turn this plush toy into a 2D cartoon game hero called Otter: a lovable, mischievous brown river otter. Keep the toy's identity: deep chocolate-brown curly fluffy fur, a wide cream muzzle and cream tummy, a big shiny black nose, small rounded ears, chunky short arms and legs. Give him large expressive friendly dark eyes with bright highlights, cute whiskers, a long thick otter tail, and a teal adventurer's scarf tied round his neck. No t-shirt. He stands upright on two feet in a relaxed happy pose, three-quarter view facing right, whole body visible, warm cheeky smile.

assets.name: mosey_ref
assets.prompt: Redraw this plush toy as ONE single 2D cartoon character illustration (one figure only: not a character sheet, no extra poses, no labels, no scenery, no water). He is a cute, friendly male mosasaur, a prehistoric sea reptile (not a land dinosaur, whale, shark or dolphin). Keep the toy's identity: bright ocean-blue body, a soft pale-grey bobbly frill running along his back and a second frill along his side, pale turquoise belly, golden-amber eyes, exactly four long paddle-shaped swimming flippers edged with pale frill, and a long aquatic tail ending in a fluke. Rounded friendly snout, gentle closed-mouth smile with small neat white pointed teeth with slightly rounded tips peeking out along the edge of his upper jaw (he is a mosasaur), still warm and friendly, never fierce, large expressive eyes with bright highlights and no eyelashes, a slightly bold brow, a cheeky boyish grin, and nothing round his neck. Relaxed floating pose, side-on three-quarter view with his head pointing to the RIGHT of the picture, whole body including tail and all four flippers visible.
assets.note: tools/raw/mosey_ref.png (and mosey_idle.png) is the approved Option A of docs/art-proposals/mosey-teeth/ (option_a.png), itself an edit of the earlier approved 'Option A' from docs/art-proposals/mosey-boy/.

assets.name: machine_whole
assets.prompt: The Tick-Tock Times Machine: a funny home-made time machine. It is an old white clawfoot bathtub on four little cart wheels, with a big round brass dial showing the numbers 1 to 12 bolted on the front like a dashboard, a large brass cog wheel on its side, a coiled copper spring sticking up at the back, a red three-bladed propeller on a pole on top, a shiny brass bell on the rim, and at the back its heart: the Times Core, a carved wooden cuckoo-clock box with a softly glowing rainbow crystal shard in its little window. Cheerful, ramshackle and lovable, three-quarter view facing right, whole machine visible. The machine is empty and parked: no driver, no characters, no animals.
assets.note: M2 look check. First take had an otter driving it; regenerated empty so the parts and wreck can be drawn from it.

assets.name: machine_wrecked
assets.prompt: This is the time machine. A small puff of smoke. One object only.

assets.name: boss_maia
assets.prompt: A big funny video-game boss dinosaur, comical and lovable, never scary: rounded chunky shapes, big expressive eyes, no sharp claws on show. One figure only, whole body visible. Side view facing LEFT: her head is at the LEFT end of her body with her duck bill pointing to the LEFT, and her long thick tail stretches out to the right. She looks where she is going, never back over her shoulder. Mama Maia, a plump, motherly Maiasaura: a hadrosaur, the duck-billed plant-eating dinosaur, with a SHORT thick neck, sturdy hind legs much bigger than her front legs, standing on all fours with her head up. Soft sage-green skin, cream belly and pale freckle spots, a wide flat duck bill, a small bony crest above her eyes, big eyes with long eyelashes. She is fussy and flustered: eyebrows raised, a worried 'oh my!' expression, one front foot lifted.
assets.note: Regenerated so every Maia pose faces one way with her head at the front (the first set had her head turned backwards).
